text: れんぞくで　だすと　しっぱい　しやすい。

structure.jp: れんぞくで　だすと
しっぱい　しやすい。

patterns.name: 〜やすい
patterns.span: しっぱい　しやすい
patterns.explanation: やすい added to a verb says it happens easily or is likely to happen. しっぱい しやすい = 'tends to fail'.

patterns.name: 〜と (when)
patterns.explanation: と after a verb says that whenever this happens, the next thing follows. れんぞくで だすと = 'if you use it in a row'.

patterns.name: 〜で (how)
patterns.explanation: で here shows the way something is done. れんぞくで = 'one after another'.
